name: Donchian ensemble 4h + vol target
label: 4h_ens3_vt
hypothesis: The 4h channel loses in quiet (PF 0.73) and drifting (PF 0.81) regimes and wins only in trending ones (1.83): 349 of its 524 trades sit in the two losing buckets. Volatility targeting does the opposite of what this needs, because a quiet market has low realised volatility and the rule increases size exactly there. Prediction: the 4h ensemble under a volatility target is worse than the same ensemble without it, and worse than the 1d version. If it improves instead, the regime diagnosis is wrong and the low-volatility losses come from something other than position size.
failure_modes: el IC del PF sigue siendo ancho con 524 trades: el Sharpe no alcanza significancia

change: Ensemble of the three 4h channel lengths plus volatility targeting.

portfolio.rationale: The three 4h channel lengths already in the registry (12, 24, 48). All three are included, including the ones that lost, so the ensemble does not become another selection. Equal weights fixed before running. Risk per trade stays at 0.5% for the portfolio, so each component carries 1/6.
